technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals present, but price remains below all key moving averages with weak trend confirmation and bearish MACD—setup lacks confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ALGN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 15 days with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no clear conviction signal; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (411.84) with flat yield curve, imminent CPI event, and earnings in 15 days create severe macro headwinds for ALGN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend reversal signal in fear-zone market creates contrarian bounce setup near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, weak ADX trend confirmation, imminent earnings (15 days), VIX crisis regime (411.84), and zero fundamental/insider conviction make this a high-risk, low-confluence entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme RSI oversold and StochRSI bullish cross present contrarian bounce potential in fear-zone conditions, price remains structurally below all major moving averages with bearish MACD and weak trend confirmation, creating low-confluence entry.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent earnings in 15 days combined with VIX crisis regime (411.84) and macro headwinds create severe event risk that could gap through support before reversal signals mature.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
